description: Stop a study, instant read, plan, audit or post simulation that is still running. Use it when the user changes their mind or a run was started with the wrong inputs. Finished runs are not affected.

id.description: run_id for a study or read, autopilotId for a plan, job_id for an audit, or the post simulation id.

kind.description: The kind named in the run tool's response.

name: aetherya_cancel
title: Cancel a running Aetherya run
